Here are a few warmer phrasings that keep the same commitment:

1) "We'll have the signed report to you by 3 p.m. on Thursday."

2) "We're pleased to confirm we'll deliver the signed report by 3 p.m. on Thursday."

3) "You can expect the signed report from us by 3 p.m. on Thursday — we're happy to get this to you."

All keep the deadline and deliverable unchanged.
